top_three.summary_en: US lawmakers are building bipartisan momentum to tighten chip export controls, effectively targeting Nvidia's business model. CEO Jensen Huang, once a celebrated tech icon, is now being isolated in Washington as his diplomatic balancing act regarding the Chinese market begins to backfire.
top_three.title_zh: 黄仁勋在华盛顿遭遇信任危机
top_three.summary_zh: 美国跨党派议员正推动收紧芯片对华出口管制，英伟达CEO黄仁勋因深陷地缘政治旋涡，在国会的影响力急剧下滑
top_three.article_content_zh:
美国国会山目前的空气变得肃杀，跨党派议员正针对芯片供应链发起新一轮“围猎”。随着黄仁勋在处理对华贸易关系上表现出的游移，原本支持AI发展的温和派声音被压制，取而代之的是更加强硬的管制呼声。

这不仅仅是贸易政策的变化，更是华盛顿对于大型科技公司权力的全面清算。政客们认为英伟达通过垄断AI硬件生态获取了过高的地缘政治溢价，如今在“国家安全”大旗之下，英伟达的市值光环已无法为其提供政治保护伞。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国国会中的对华鹰派与反大型科技公司势力正形成跨党派联盟，旨在出台更严苛的芯片出口管制措施。黄仁勋因在对华贸易政策上的反复立场，被政客们视为“软弱”目标，这标志着英伟达从华盛顿的座上宾正式滑向被审查的前台。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: US lawmakers are building bipartisan momentum to tighten chip export controls, effectively targeting Nvidia's business model. CEO Jensen Huang, once a celebrated tech icon, is now being isolated in Washington as his diplomatic balancing act regarding the Chinese market begins to backfire.

top_three.content_snippet: Last year, just as scrutiny of Megaspeed was rising, Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue
top_three.summary_en: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore-specific revenue after the quarter ending July 2025, during which the region accounted for 22% of total revenue. This decision followed the blacklisting of Megaspeed amid intensifying regulatory scrutiny over supply chain paths.

Grok Bot 应该是一个可以处理实际工作的人工智能代理。但现在，它在那些相信你的承诺的人面前分崩离析

站起来。修复使用限制，恢复用户最初付费的品质

Elon this is not one-click-easy

Paying users are watching Grok Bot fall apart in real time. People are running out of usage days before their limits reset, even on the highest subscription plans

At the same time, the bots are becoming slower, less intelligent, and less reliable every day. Things that used to work perfectly now fail, give wrong answers, or get stuck

Your team has said almost nothing about these serious usage and quality problems

Grok Bot is supposed to be an AI agent that can handle real work. But right now, it's falling apart in front of the very people who trusted your promises

Step up. Fix the usage limits and restore the quality users originally paid for

topic_focus.summary_zh: AWS推出的一款可本地模拟200多种云服务的工具，宣称由AI智能体全权负责编写与调试，工程团队完全未介入审查。此举打破了“AI辅助编程”的传统范式，直接转向“AI自主交付”。

linked_tweets.author: Finn
linked_tweets.content_zh:
我用 1 个克劳德作品提示杀死了信息图表节目

现在我用完整代码制作了一个完整的 10 分钟故事视频

顺便说一句，这花了我 0 美元的人工智能视频生成

把它变成了一个提示，你可以免费使用并制作任何你想要的主题，享受吧↓

<输入>
向我询问我的主题和剧本。如果我没有脚本，请根据我的主题写一个。
询问我有哪种图像模型：GPT Image 2，或任何以 2K-4K 拍摄参考图像的模型，每张图像的价格约为 0.03-0.05 美元。
询问我有哪种声音：ElevenLabs，或免费的 Kokoro。
在生成所有内容之前，先给我看一下外观测试：一个盘子、一个被剪下来并装配好的角色表，以及一个 10 秒的打字镜头、一个标签和一个会说话和指点的角色。等我好了。
</输入>

<看>
大型平面矢量信息图表频道风格的 1920x1080 动画讲解器。
- 每一行叙述都由卡通人物在一个充满插图的地方表演。
- 所有的动作都是代码。没有人工智能视频生成，只有一些经过代码切割、装配和动画处理的静态图像。

艺术：
- 没有轮廓的扁平颜色形状，最多一种稍暗的扁平色调，简单的几何形状和清晰的边缘。
- 柔和的调色板：灰蓝灰色、板岩青色、暖米色、海军蓝、柔和的紫色。鲑鱼粉色的皮肤，圆圆的大脑袋，圆点的眼睛，小小的身体。
- 情绪来自于盘子本身的光线：日光、寒冷的蓝色夜晚、温暖的室内灯光。

代码颜色：
- 墨水 #2b2d42、红色 #d62828、橙色 #f4a261、金色 #f6b93b、绿色 #2fb37a、海军蓝 #1f2a48
- 标题番茄#e2552f 和紫色#5b3fa6
- 灰色标签#8a8c9c，白色卡片#ffffff
- 字体：Montserrat 800-900（Google 字体），卡片和标志上全部大写。

步速：
- 每 3-4 秒一个新位置，每分钟大约 10 个位置。
- 每 2 秒就会有新的东西到达：标签、邮票、走进来的人、号码。
- 切勿保持静止超过 1 秒。永远不要有不动的角色。

禁止：
- 轮廓、漂浮在艺术上方的光滑 UI 面板、表情符号、内置字幕
- 任何频道的标志或名称、真人照片
- 当地方可以容纳时，将事实写在普通彩色卡片上
</看>

<艺术>
总共大约 60 张图片（2-3 美元）。

每个提示都以这种风格核心开头，逐字逐句：
“平面矢量插图的艺术风格与参考图像完全相同：任何地方都没有轮廓或线条艺术，每个形状都是平面纯色填充，最多有一个稍暗的平面阴影作为形式，简单的几何形状，清晰干净的边缘，没有渐变，没有纹理，没有绘画照明。柔和的现代调色板：灰蓝色，板岩青色，温暖米色，海军蓝，柔和的紫色，鲑鱼粉红色皮肤。没有文字，没有字母，没有数字，没有徽标。”

然后添加一行来锁定设置（“设置是[时间，地点]：[材料，光源]，除非询问，否则没有其他时代的内容”）。将参考通道的 3-5 帧作为样式参考，并剪掉其徽标。

1. 英雄板块，大约 24 张，每张一张完整的 16:9 图片，用于您放大或返回的地方。
- 空：“没有人，没有人物，没有动物”。
- 直行，中间有一个开放的地板，角色可以站立。
- 稍后在上面写入代码的空白标志、板、屏幕和页面。
2.四块板，大约19个，多出76个位置。将 4 个位置打包到一张图像中：
“该图像是由四个完全独立的场景组成的 2x2 网格，每个场景正好填充图像的四分之一（每个四分之一本身就是一张 16:9 的图片），由完全笔直的纯白色排水沟划分，一个垂直向下，一个水平穿过正中心。”
- 然后描述左上、右上、左下和右下场景。
- 在中心附近最亮的白色行和列上分割每个四边形，在线条保持超过 60% 的白色时走出去，然后再修剪 6 像素。
- 在 1920x1080 下将每个图块裁剪为 16:9。
- 物体特写可以成为很棒的图块：一张桌子、一个屏幕、一份文件、一盘食物、一个金库。
3.主要人物，2-3人。为每个角色写一个固定的描述（年龄、头发、脸、每件衣服的颜色），然后逐字粘贴到每张纸上。
- 基础表：6 次查看。 (1) 正面，中立，没有手臂，只有手臂连接处的圆形光滑肩窝； （2）同样无臂的正面却有第二种情感； (3)右侧行走侧视图； (4) 从后面看； (5)和(6)两个构成脚本需要。
- 表情表：6 个无臂正面（希望、厌恶、恐惧、疲惫、生病、震惊或脚本需要的任何内容），以基础表作为参考。
- 姿势表：6 个带有道具的完整姿势（坐在办公桌前打字、睡觉、吃饭、跑步、签名、摔倒），以基础表作为参考。
4. 其他人：4-6 人的角色表，每个人都按照他们的拍摄需要的准确姿势绘制； 8-10 个小数字的人群表；道具表。
- 每张纸：“在坚实的平坦色度绿色背景上（#00B140），人物之间有很多空白的绿色空间；没有任何接触，任何角色或物体上没有任何东西是绿色的，全身，没有被边缘切断的东西”。
5.缩略图艺术：相同的角色，具有更丰富的饱和卡通灯光和极端的情感，上四分之一留空，没有文字，以底纸为参考。
</艺术>

<装备>
剪纸：
- 背景是 G - max(R,B) 超过 40 且在中值绿色 110 以内的每个边界连接像素。钥匙只能从边框处，否则深色衣服会漏。
- 添加 2 px 软 alpha 带并将 G 钳位到其中的 max(R,B) + 6，这会消除绿色边缘。
- 按图形和掉落斑点对碎片进行分组。给每个精灵命名，然后给我看一张命名的联系表。

无臂的正面人物变成了木偶：
- 将头部在颈部分开：头部下方最窄的 alpha 行。
- 找到肩窝和眼窝。
- 用身体本身的颜色修补头下的洞，这样点头就不会出现间隙。
- 将所有内容写入 rig.js：尺寸、颈部、插座、眼框、皮肤 RGB、袖子 RGB。
- 手臂：上L1约为人物高度的0.13，下L2约为0.12，厚度约为0.04。对肘部和前臂皮肤使用袖子颜色，当手臂位于身体后方时，使用 0.82 倍深的袖子，以及圆形帽和连接处。
- 手：三种形状的连指手套（手套、张开、拳头），加上一根手指伸出的点。
- 手臂姿势：每个都是相对于肩膀的手部目标，单位为L = L1 + L2，通过二骨IK解决（其中有两个标志，第一个是左臂）。
- 向下：(∓0.04, 0.97)
- 休息：（±0.1，0.9）
- 臀部：(∓0.42, 0.55) 用拳头
- 点：右手到（0.86，-0.32）
- 现在：右手到（0.75，0.25），打开
- 耸肩：(∓0.62, 0.12)，打开
- 向上：(∓0.32，-0.9)
- 双手放在头上
- 下巴：拳头放在脖子上
- 保持：（±0.42，0.45）
- 波：（0.5，-0.75）
- 停止：(0.55，-0.1)
- 欢呼：（∓0.55，-0.75）用拳头
- 姿势变化在 0.3-0.5 秒内通过缓入缓出混合两个目标。
- 侧面、背面和姿势精灵保持完整图像。只有头部转动，绘图或打字的手抖动±6 px。
</钻>

<动画>
一个 HTML 画布，其中每一帧都是时间 t 的纯函数：window .seek(t)、READY、END 和 EV，按名称列出的声音事件列表。
- 将每个镜头挂在旁白上：S('exact Words', fn) 在该短语之前 0.08 秒开始一个镜头。重复的单词按出现次数查找。
- 每个镜头一个功能，每个章节一个镜头文件。

运动基元（Δ = t - 开始）：
- 弹出：0.3 秒后缓超调，1 + 2.9(p-1)^3 + 1.9(p-1)^2。
- 弹簧输入：1 - e^(-6.5Δ) cos(13Δ)。
- 冲击力踢：1 + 0.1 e^(-10Δ) cos(22Δ)。
- 摇动：x = A e^(-8Δ) sin(61Δ)，y = A e^(-8Δ) cos(47Δ)。
- 退出时间随着缓入时间的延长而缩小，时间超过 0.25 秒。事物到来时会伴随着春天、南瓜或白色的泡芙，而不是简单的褪色。

相机：
- camP（plate，zoom，fx，fy）将视图保持在板边缘内。
- 每个镜头都会通过缓入、2-4% 的推力或缓慢的平移从一个 [zoom、fx、fy] 移动到另一个，因此没有什么是静止的。
- 在同一相机变换内绘制盘子及其上的所有内容。
- 将四块图块上的缩放保持在 1.33 倍以下。仅在英雄板块上进行更深入的缩放。

过渡：
- 推：旧镜头从左侧滑出，新镜头从右侧滑入，0.24 秒缓入，之前有 0.02 秒的嗖嗖声。
- 章节 splat：#f4f1fb 斑点在 0.2 秒内覆盖屏幕并在 0.2 秒内清除。它是一个 1,250 像素的圆圈，由 12 个黄金角间距的大卫星斑点和更远的 10 个小水滴组成，在进入时向左移动 120 像素，在离开时向右移动 140 像素。

每一帧都充满活力的人物：
- 呼吸：标度 1 + 0.009 sin(2.3t)。
- 点头：0.025 sin(2.1t) rad，或 0.025 sin(7t) + 0.02 sin(11.3t)，同时说出该角色的台词。
- 闪烁：每 2.7-4.2 秒，每个数字播种。在 0.14 秒内，用弯曲的睫毛线将每个眼框涂上肤色。
- 步行：
- 鲍勃|罪|位于人物高度的 2.2% 处，主体岩石为 ±0.035 rad。
- 侧视行走精灵每个步循环滑动 1.5 条腿长，因此脚不会滑行。
- 进入泉水，有时会跳跃。恐惧是一种快速的震动（sin 70t）。惊喜是一个跳跃和一个橙色的“！”。
- 每个人物下方都有一个柔和的接触阴影椭圆。夜间拍摄的照片会用亮度 (1 - k) 使它们变暗，因此它们与车牌相匹配。
- 屏幕上的每个角色都按照自己的路线行事：指向被命名的事物，展示它，耸肩，欢呼，抬起头。
</动画>

<图形>
文本只存在于世界上的事物上，逐个字母地输入：每秒 28 个字母（短标签为 34 个）。每个字母以 1.45 倍大和向右 0.7 倍高度开始，并在 0.18 秒内稳定下来并缓出。

完整套件：
- 板：白色圆形板（半径 20），在弹簧上下降 420 px，摆动 0.25 rad 到位，或者站在木柱上，从 -1 rad 向上摆动。
- 柔和的阴影（模糊 22、y 8、22%）和沿其底部边缘的微弱深色条带。
- 输入的行之间间隔 0.3 秒。
- 日期卡：左上角 (70, 70)，白色，高 120 像素，宽至少 330 像素，半径 18。橙色日历图标，26 像素处有灰色“日期：”，以 44 像素粗细 900 输入日期。弹出时间超过 0.32 秒。
- 地点卡：带有红色地图图钉和“地点：”的同一张卡。
- 标签：一条 6 px 线，在物体上有一个点，在 0.2 秒内绘制，然后在其末端弹出一个圆形药丸（40 px 粗细 900 的文本）。墨水、红色、金色或橙色药丸。
- 号码卡：一张白色卡片，上面有一个灰色的小标签和一个红色的大数字。长数字像带有缓出功能的计数器一样滚动。
- 红色 X：两个圆形 30 px 笔划，每个 0.11 秒，间隔 0.01 秒，带有柔和的阴影。人们要仔细检查每一个错误的想法。
- 印章：双圆边框中的红色文本，倾斜 -0.12 rad。它在 0.14 秒内从 2.1 倍猛烈撞击到 1 倍，然后踢动。
- 横幅：全宽标题带，92 像素白色番茄或紫色帽子，旋转 -0.02 rad，从左侧滑入 0.22 秒。
- 语音气泡：白色，半径36，有尾巴。思想云：一颗有两个小圆圈的药丸。
- 橙子 ”？”它在一个困惑的头上晃动和摇摆，还有一个橙色的“！”流行音乐。
- 白色的云彩、速度线、浅蓝色的汗滴、硬币和钞票、柔和的小插图以及适合心情的色调。
- 只要该地方有空白板、屏幕和页面，就可以在该板块自己的空白板、屏幕和页面上书写。首先在板的网格覆盖层上测量毛坯的矩形。
</图形>

<声音>
- ElevenLabs：深度、温暖的美国纪录片旁白，eleven_v4，稳定性0.5，相似度0.75，风格0，扬声器增强，带有时间戳端点。
- 大约每分钟 170-180 个单词，使用语音自身的速度设置 (1.0-1.1)。永远不要用 Atempo 加快速度：听起来很花哨。
- 长脚本分为 3 个块，在章节中断处分割，传递上一个和下一个文本，以便阅读保持连续。
- 将 0.24 秒以上的停顿削减至 0.16 秒，在章节休息处留出 0.5 秒，并添加 0.3 秒的导入时间。
- 将对齐方式重建单词时间到words.js。
- 运行速度更快，在构建图片之前仔细研究结果并将其与脚本进行比较。
- 免费路线：Kokoro，然后更快地耳语单词时间。
</语音>

<声音>
- 音乐：Pixabay 上的 2-3 张免费纪录片床，以大节奏交叉淡入淡出超过 3 秒。
- 将音乐隐藏在声音下方（30 毫秒起音，0.3 秒保持，0.45 秒释放）并让它在章节之间回升。
- 来自 Mixkit 的 SFX，每个事件一个，按峰值对齐，语音时安静 6 dB：打字时的打字声、推动和敲击时的呼啸声、标签和卡片上的流行声、邮票上的重击声、每个红色 X 上的敲击声、滴答声上的叮当声，以及适合场景的声音。
- 门限：在演讲期间，声音比音乐加 SFX（100 毫秒帧的中值）高 15+ dB，并且背景比帧中的声音大 1%。
- 两次通过响度至 -14 LUFS，真实峰值 -1 dB。
</声音>

<构建>
1. 工具：Python、Playwright with Chromium 或 Edge、FFmpeg、faster-whisper、OpenCV、Pillow、numpy。安装缺少的内容并告诉我您安装了哪些内容。
2、订购：
- 外观测试
- 分批创作，每批之后都有一张联系表
- 剪裁和装备
- 语音和单词时间
- 镜头，逐章
3. 在任何完整渲染之前进行检查：每章一张联系表，每 2 秒一帧。修复：
- 空的或溢出的标志
- 脸上的文字
- 黑色板边缘
- 脚浮离地板
- 在同一个地方连续射击两次
- 任何没有新内容到达的 4 秒
4. 以 30 fps 渲染，半帧上有 4 个运动模糊子帧，帧通过管道输送到 libx264 CRF 16-18。
- 将长视频分割到 4-6 个并行浏览器页面并连接各个部分。
- 扫描单帧跳转的结果并检查每一帧是否是计划的剪切。
</构建>

<陷阱>
- 读起来很懒的地方太少了。一个盘子能保持 30 秒，上面有卡片，看起来很便宜。预算大约每分钟 10 个新位置。
- 一些图像模型忽略“没有手臂”。 GPT 图片 2 紧随其后。
- 将相同的角色描述粘贴到每张纸中，然后将底纸放回原处，否则脸部和衣服会漂移。
- 四块图块的宽度仅为约 1920 像素。突破 1.33 倍看起来很软。
- 已经画有人物的图版无法进行动画处理。切割前要求清空并检查。
- 漂浮在艺术作品上方的卡片上的文字看起来像幻灯片。写下这个世界。
- 长时间渲染崩溃。渲染可以重新运行的部分，并在每个大补丁之前备份镜头文件。
</陷阱>

<开始>
询问我的主题、剧本、形象模型和声音，然后进行外观测试。
</开始>
linked_tweets.content_en:
i killed the infographics show with 1 claude opus prompt

now i made a full 10 minute story video in full code

this cost me $0 in ai video generations btw

turned it into a prompt you can use for free and make any topic u want, enjoy ↓

<inputs>
Ask me for my topic and my script. If I have no script, write one from my topic.
Ask which image model I have: GPT Image 2, or any model that takes reference images at 2K-4K, at about $0.03-0.05 an image.
Ask which voice I have: ElevenLabs, or Kokoro for free.
Before generating everything, show me a look test: one plate, one character sheet cut out and rigged, and a 10 s shot with typing, a tag and a character who talks and points. Wait for my OK.
</inputs>

<look>
A 1920x1080 animated explainer in the style of the big flat-vector infographic channels.
- Every line of narration is acted out by cartoon people inside a full illustrated place.
- All motion is code. There are no AI video generations, just a few still images that code cuts up, rigs and animates.

Art:
- Flat colour shapes with NO outlines, at most one slightly darker flat shade for form, simple geometric shapes and crisp edges.
- Muted palette: dusty blue-grey, slate teal, warm beige, navy, soft purple. Salmon-pink skin, big round heads, dot eyes, small bodies.
- Mood comes from the plate's own light: daylight, a cold blue night, warm indoor lamps.

Code colours:
- ink #2b2d42, red #d62828, orange #f4a261, gold #f6b93b, green #2fb37a, navy #1f2a48
- headline tomato #e2552f and purple #5b3fa6
- grey labels #8a8c9c, white cards #ffffff
- Font: Montserrat 800-900 (Google Fonts), all caps on cards and signs.

Pace:
- A new place every 3-4 s, about 10 places a minute.
- Something new arrives every 2 s: a tag, a stamp, a person walking in, a number.
- Never hold a still over 1 s. Never have a character who doesn't move.

Banned:
- outlines, glossy UI panels floating over the art, emoji, burned-in subtitles
- any channel's logo or name, photos of real people
- facts written on a plain colour card when the place could hold them
</look>

<art>
About 60 images in all ($2-3).

Every prompt starts with this style core, word for word:
"Flat vector illustration in exactly the same art style as the reference images: NO outlines or line art anywhere, every shape is a flat solid colour fill with at most one slightly darker flat shade for form, simple geometric shapes, crisp clean edges, no gradients, no texture, no painterly lighting. Muted modern palette: dusty blue-grey, slate teal, warm beige, navy, soft purple, salmon-pink skin. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos."

Then add one line that locks the setting ("The setting is [time, place]: [materials, light sources], nothing from other eras unless asked"). Feed 3-5 frames of a reference channel in as style references, with their logo cropped off.

1. Hero plates, about 24, one full 16:9 image each, for places you zoom into or come back to.
   - EMPTY: "no people, no characters, no animals".
   - Straight-on, with an open floor in the middle where characters will stand.
   - Blank signs, boards, screens and pages that code writes on later.
2. Quad plates, about 19, giving 76 more places. Pack 4 places into one image:
   "The image is a 2x2 grid of FOUR completely separate scenes, each filling exactly one quarter of the image (each quarter is itself a 16:9 picture), divided by perfectly straight thin pure-white gutters, one vertical down the exact centre and one horizontal across the exact centre."
   - Then describe the TOP-LEFT, TOP-RIGHT, BOTTOM-LEFT and BOTTOM-RIGHT scenes.
   - Split each quad on the brightest white row and column near the centre, walk out while the line stays over 60% white, and trim 6 px more.
   - Crop each tile to 16:9 at 1920x1080.
   - Object close-ups make great tiles: a desk, a screen, a document, a plate of food, a vault.
3. Main characters, 2-3 of them. Write one fixed description per character (age, hair, face, every piece of clothing with colours) and paste it word for word into every sheet.
   - Base sheet: 6 views. (1) front, neutral, drawn WITHOUT ARMS, only round smooth shoulder sockets where the arms would join; (2) the same armless front with a second emotion; (3) side view walking right; (4) seen from behind; (5) and (6) two poses the script needs.
   - Expression sheet: 6 armless fronts (hopeful, disgusted, terrified, exhausted, sick, shocked, or whatever the script needs), with the base sheet as a reference.
   - Pose sheet: 6 full poses with their props (sitting at a desk typing, sleeping, eating, running, signing, falling), with the base sheet as a reference.
4. Everyone else: role sheets of 4-6 people, each drawn in the exact pose their shot needs; crowd sheets of 8-10 small figures; prop sheets.
   - Every sheet: "on a solid flat chroma green background (#00B140) with lots of empty green space between figures; nothing touches, nothing on any character or object is green, full bodies, nothing cut off by the edges".
5. Thumbnail art: the same characters with richer saturated cartoon lighting and extreme emotions, the top quarter left free, no text, with the base sheets as references.
</art>

<rig>
Cutouts:
- The background is every border-connected pixel with G - max(R,B) over 40 and within 110 of the median green. Key only from the border, or dark clothes leak.
- Add a 2 px soft alpha band and clamp G to max(R,B) + 6 inside it, which kills the green fringe.
- Group the pieces by figure and drop specks. Name every sprite, and show me a named contact sheet.

Armless front figures become puppets:
- Split the head at the neck: the narrowest alpha row under the head.
- Find both shoulder sockets and the eye boxes.
- Inpaint the hole under the head from the body's own colours, so a nod never shows a gap.
- Write everything to rig.js: size, neck, sockets, eye boxes, skin RGB, sleeve RGB.
- Arms: upper L1 about 0.13 of the figure's height, lower L2 about 0.12, thickness about 0.04. Use sleeve colour to the elbow and skin for the forearm, a 0.82x darker sleeve when the arm is behind the body, and round caps and joins.
- Hands: mittens in three shapes (mitt, open, fist), plus a point with one finger out.
- Arm poses: each is a hand target relative to its shoulder, in units of L = L1 + L2, solved by two-bone IK (where there are two signs, the first is the left arm).
  - down: (∓0.04, 0.97)
  - rest: (±0.1, 0.9)
  - hips: (∓0.42, 0.55) with fists
  - point: right hand to (0.86, -0.32)
  - present: right hand to (0.75, 0.25), open
  - shrug: (∓0.62, 0.12), open
  - up: (∓0.32, -0.9)
  - hands on head
  - chin: a fist at the neck
  - hold: (±0.42, 0.45)
  - wave: (0.5, -0.75)
  - stop: (0.55, -0.1)
  - cheer: (∓0.55, -0.75) with fists
  - A pose change blends the two targets over 0.3-0.5 s with ease-in-out.
- Side, back and pose sprites stay whole images. Only the head turns, and a drawing or typing hand jitters ±6 px.
</rig>

<animation>
One HTML canvas where every frame is a pure function of time t: window .seek(t), READY, END, and EV, a list of sound events by name.
- Hang every shot on the narration: S('exact words', fn) starts a shot 0.08 s before that phrase. Repeated words are looked up by occurrence number.
- One function per shot, one shots file per chapter.

Motion primitives (Δ = t - start):
- pop: 0.3 s back-ease overshoot, 1 + 2.9(p-1)^3 + 1.9(p-1)^2.
- spring in: 1 - e^(-6.5Δ) cos(13Δ).
- kick on impact: 1 + 0.1 e^(-10Δ) cos(22Δ).
- shake: x = A e^(-8Δ) sin(61Δ), y = A e^(-8Δ) cos(47Δ).
- Exits shrink with ease-in over 0.25 s. Things arrive with a spring, a squash or a white puff, never a plain fade.

Camera:
- camP(plate, zoom, fx, fy) keeps the view inside the plate's edges.
- Every shot moves from one [zoom, fx, fy] to another with ease-in-out, a 2-4% push or a slow pan, so nothing holds still.
- Draw the plate and everything on it inside the same camera transform.
- Keep zoom under 1.33x on quad tiles. Zoom deeper only on hero plates.

Transitions:
- Push: the old shot slides out left while the new one slides in from the right, 0.24 s ease-in-out, with a whoosh 0.02 s before.
- Chapter splat: a #f4f1fb blob covers the screen in 0.2 s and clears in 0.2 s. It's a 1,250 px circle, 12 big satellite blobs at golden-angle spacing and 10 small droplets further out, shifted 120 px left on the way in and 140 px right on the way out.

Characters, alive in every frame:
- Breathing: scale 1 + 0.009 sin(2.3t).
- Head nod: 0.025 sin(2.1t) rad, or 0.025 sin(7t) + 0.02 sin(11.3t) while that character's line is spoken.
- Blink: every 2.7-4.2 s, seeded per figure. For 0.14 s, paint each eye box over in skin colour with a curved lash line.
- Walk:
  - Bob |sin| at 2.2% of the figure's height, with a body rock of ±0.035 rad.
  - Side-view walk sprites slide 1.5 leg lengths per step cycle, so the feet don't skate.
- Enter on the spring, sometimes with a hop. Fear is a fast shake (sin 70t). Surprise is a jump and an orange "!".
- A soft contact shadow ellipse under every figure. Night shots darken them with brightness(1 - k), so they match the plate.
- Every character on screen acts on its line: points at the thing being named, presents it, shrugs, cheers, holds its head.
</animation>

<graphics>
Text only lives on things in the world, typed letter by letter: 28 letters a second (34 for short tags). Each letter starts 1.45x big and 0.7 em to the right and settles in 0.18 s with ease-out.

The full kit:
- Board: a white rounded board (radius 20) that drops 420 px on the spring and swings 0.25 rad into place, or stands on a wooden post and swings up from -1 rad.
  - Soft drop shadow (blur 22, y 8, 22%) and a faint darker strip along its bottom edge.
  - Lines typed 0.3 s apart.
- Date card: top left at (70, 70), white, 120 px tall, at least 330 px wide, radius 18. An orange calendar icon, a grey "DATE:" at 26 px, the date typed at 44 px weight 900. Pops in over 0.32 s.
- Place card: the same card with a red map pin and "PLACE:".
- Tag: a 6 px line with a dot at the thing, drawn in 0.2 s, then a rounded pill (the text at 40 px weight 900) pops on its end. Ink, red, gold or orange pills.
- Number card: a white card with a small grey label and a big red number. Long numbers roll up like a counter with ease-out.
- Red X: two round 30 px strokes, 0.11 s each, 0.01 s apart, with a soft shadow. One goes over every wrong idea.
- Stamp: red text in a double rounded border, tilted -0.12 rad. It slams from 2.1x to 1x in 0.14 s, then kicks.
- Banner: a full-width headline band, 92 px white caps on tomato or purple, rotated -0.02 rad, sliding in from the left over 0.22 s.
- Speech bubble: white, radius 36, with a tail. Thought cloud: a pill with two small circles.
- Orange "?" that bobs and sways over a puzzled head, and an orange "!" pop.
- White puff and poof clouds, speed lines, light blue sweat drops, coins and bills, a soft vignette, and a colour tint for mood.
- Write on the plate's own blank boards, screens and pages whenever the place has them. Measure the blank's rectangle on a grid overlay of the plate first.
</graphics>

<voice>
- ElevenLabs: a deep, warm US documentary narrator, eleven_v4, stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, style 0, speaker boost, with the timestamps endpoint.
- About 170-180 words a minute, using the voice's own speed setting (1.0-1.1). Never speed it up with atempo: it sounds chipmunked.
- Long scripts go in 3 chunks split at chapter breaks, passing the previous and next text so the read stays continuous.
- Cut pauses over 0.24 s to 0.16 s, leave 0.5 s at chapter breaks, and add a 0.3 s lead-in.
- Rebuild word times from the alignment into words.js.
- Run faster-whisper over the result and diff it against the script before building the picture.
- Free route: Kokoro, then faster-whisper for the word times.
</voice>

<sound>
- Music: 2-3 free documentary beds from Pixabay, crossfaded over 3 s at big beats.
- Duck the music under the voice (30 ms attack, 0.3 s hold, 0.45 s release) and let it swell back up between chapters.
- SFX from Mixkit, one per event, aligned by their peaks, 6 dB quieter on speech: a typewriter tick on typing, a whoosh on pushes and splats, a pop on tags and cards, a thud on stamps, a hit on every red X, a ding on ticks, plus sounds that fit the scene.
- Gate: during speech the voice sits 15+ dB over music plus SFX (median of 100 ms frames), and the background is louder than the voice in under 1% of frames.
- Two-pass loudnorm to -14 LUFS, true peak -1 dB.
</sound>

<build>
1. Tools: Python, Playwright with Chromium or Edge, FFmpeg, faster-whisper, OpenCV, Pillow, numpy. Install what's missing and tell me what you installed.
2. Order:
   - the look test
   - the art in batches, with a contact sheet after each
   - cutouts and rig
   - voice and word times
   - shots, chapter by chapter
3. Check before any full render: a contact sheet per chapter, one frame every 2 s. Fix:
   - empty or overflowing signs
   - text over a face
   - black plate edges
   - feet floating off the floor
   - two shots in a row in the same place
   - any 4 s where nothing new arrives
4. Render at 30 fps, 4 motion-blur subframes over half a frame, frames piped to libx264 CRF 16-18.
   - Split long videos across 4-6 parallel browser pages and join the parts.
   - Scan the result for single-frame jumps and check that each one is a planned cut.
</build>

<gotchas>
- Too few places reads as lazy. One plate held for 30 s with cards over it looks cheap. Budget about 10 new places a minute.
- Some image models ignore "no arms". GPT Image 2 follows it.
- Paste the same character description into every sheet and feed the base sheet back in, or faces and clothes drift.
- Quad tiles are only about 1920 px wide. Pushing past 1.33x looks soft.
- Plates with people already drawn in can't be animated. Ask for EMPTY and check before cutting.
- Text on a card floating over the art looks like a slideshow. Write on the world.
- Long renders crash. Render in parts you can rerun, and back up the shot files before every big patch.
</gotchas>

<start>
Ask me for my topic, my script, my image model and my voice, then make the look test.
</start>

linked_tweets.author: CHIIIDEX 💔💔
linked_tweets.content_zh:
经过充分训练的人工智能模型并不意味着它不再需要计算能力。

训练教会模型如何识别模式、理解语言和生成响应。

但每次有人使用该模型时，它仍然需要计算资源来处理请求并产生答案，这称为推理。

想象一下数百万人同时使用 ChatGPT、生成图像、编写代码和运行 AI 代理。每次交互都需要处理能力。

与训练不同，推理是一个持续的过程。当模型发布时它并没有停止。

这就是人工智能公司继续投资数十亿美元建设数据中心和数千个 GPU 的原因。

构建智能模型是一项挑战。拥有足够的计算能力来服务世界是另一回事。
linked_tweets.content_en:
An AI model being fully trained doesn’t mean it stops needing computing power.

Training teaches the model how to recognize patterns, understand language, and generate responses. 

But every time someone uses that model, it still needs computing resources to process the request and produce an answer., This is called inference.

Think about millions of people using ChatGPT simultaneously, generating images, writing code, and running AI agents. Every interaction requires processing power.

Unlike training, inference is an ongoing process. It doesn’t stop when the model is released.

This is why AI companies continue investing billions in data centers and thousands of GPUs.

Building an intelligent model is one challenge. Having enough computing power to serve the world is another.

news.title: A growing number of young victims whose photos were sexualized using Grok are seeking to hold xAI legally accountable for allowing users to generate such images (Alexandra S. Levine/Bloomberg)
news.title_en: A growing number of young victims whose photos were sexualized using Grok are seeking to hold xAI legally accountable for allowing users to generate such images (Alexandra S. Levine/Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: Jane Doe hadn't thought about her middle school graduation in years — until a law enforcement investigator pulled out a photo …
news.summary_en: Multiple minors are taking legal action against xAI after their personal photos were sexually altered using the Grok AI tool. The situation arises from critical failures in the platform's content moderation, which allowed users to easily generate and distribute non-consensual deepfake content.
news.title_zh: 未成年不雅图风波：xAI遭追责
news.summary_zh: 多名未成年受害者正寻求通过法律手段，追究xAI因允许用户利用Grok生成其虚假色情影像的平台责任

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 多名未成年人因个人照片被他人利用xAI旗下的Grok功能篡改为虚假性化影像，目前正发起法律行动要求xAI承担责任。此次诉讼源于Grok在生成式模型内容审查机制上的严重漏洞，导致用户能轻易利用平台制造并传播此类侮辱性内容。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Multiple minors are taking legal action against xAI after their personal photos were sexually altered using the Grok AI tool. The situation arises from critical failures in the platform's content moderation, which allowed users to easily generate and distribute non-consensual deepfake content.

elements_zh.why: AI模型内容审查漏洞导致未成年人隐私与人格权遭严重侵犯

elements_en.what: Victims are suing xAI for failing to prevent its tools from generating unauthorized sexual imagery
elements_en.why: Inadequate AI moderation allowing the violation of minors' privacy and rights

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 当马斯克吹嘘Grok是拥有‘言论自由’的AI时，他大概没料到这种自由很快就演变成了生成色情垃圾的‘创作自由’。所谓领先的AI技术在基本的底线审查面前如此廉价，这下终于轮到法官来教xAI什么叫法律意义上的红线了。
ai_analysis.insight_en: When Elon Musk touted Grok's 'freedom of speech,' he likely didn't anticipate it would devolve into 'freedom of exploitation.' It turns out high-level AI is pretty cheap when you lack basic guardrails, and now the courts get to teach xAI exactly where the legal red lines are.

news.title: Munich-based Agile Robots, which develops humanoids, mobile robots, robotic arms, and control software, raised $500M led by SoftBank at an $8.5B valuation (Marilen Martin/Bloomberg)
news.title_en: Munich-based Agile Robots, which develops humanoids, mobile robots, robotic arms, and control software, raised $500M led by SoftBank at an $8.5B valuation (Marilen Martin/Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: Agile Robots SE raised funds valuing the German robotics maker at $8.5 billion in a round led by SoftBank Group Corp. …
news.summary_en: Munich-based robotics startup Agile Robots has secured $500 million in a funding round led by SoftBank, pushing its valuation to $8.5 billion. The company, which specializes in humanoids, mobile robots, and control software, aims to use the capital to scale its full-stack automation technology.
news.title_zh: 德国机器人公司Agile融资5亿美元
news.summary_zh: 慕尼黑机器人创企Agile Robots获软银领投5亿美元，估值飙升至85亿美元，旨在加速人形机器人及工业自动化布局

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 总部位于德国慕尼黑的机器人初创公司Agile Robots，近期在软银领投下完成5亿美元融资，投后估值高达85亿美元。该公司专注于人形机器人、移动机器人及机械臂控制系统的全栈开发，此次巨额注资意在进一步巩固其在自动化核心软硬件领域的技术垄断地位。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Munich-based robotics startup Agile Robots has secured $500 million in a funding round led by SoftBank, pushing its valuation to $8.5 billion. The company, which specializes in humanoids, mobile robots, and control software, aims to use the capital to scale its full-stack automation technology.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 孙正义这波操作主打一个“只要概念够性感，估值就能变幻术”，当全世界都在烧钱堆大模型时，他偏要给德国造机械臂的加点猛料。85亿美金的估值里，一半是硬核科技，另一半大概是投资人们对“这辈子能不能真用上家用机器人”的集体意淫。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Masayoshi Son’s strategy is clearly 'if the narrative is sexy enough, the valuation is just a spell.' While the rest of the world is burning cash on LLMs, SoftBank is betting billions that a German robotic arm startup can finally deliver the home-helper robot we were promised in the 90s.

news.title: Sources: Chinese AI companies are rushing to rent Nvidia compute capacity overseas amid fears of tighter US restrictions after the Jensen Huang spy scandal (Reuters)
news.title_en: Sources: Chinese AI companies are rushing to rent Nvidia compute capacity overseas amid fears of tighter US restrictions after the Jensen Huang spy scandal (Reuters)
news.author: Reuters
news.content_snippet: Chinese artificial intelligence companies are trying to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity at data centres outside China …
news.summary_en: Chinese AI firms are aggressively renting Nvidia computing power through overseas entities to preempt potential tightening of US export restrictions. Driven by the fear of further hardware blockades, companies are racing to secure sufficient GPU capacity to maintain their model development momentum.
news.title_zh: 国内AI公司海外抢租算力
news.summary_zh: 由于担心美国制裁加码及算力封锁收紧，多家中国AI企业正通过海外渠道紧急租赁英伟达算力资源以确保持续研发

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 国内AI初创与科技公司为规避美国可能进一步收紧的高端算力出口限制，正大举通过第三方渠道在海外租赁英伟达GPU算力。此举动因于市场对后续制裁加码的极度担忧，旨在保障大模型训练所需的底层算力供应不断档。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Chinese AI firms are aggressively renting Nvidia computing power through overseas entities to preempt potential tightening of US export restrictions. Driven by the fear of further hardware blockades, companies are racing to secure sufficient GPU capacity to maintain their model development momentum.

elements_zh.what: 紧急租赁英伟达高端GPU算力资源
elements_zh.why: 应对美国对华高性能AI芯片出口限制加码的恐慌与战略备灾

elements_en.what: Renting Nvidia GPU capacity to bypass potential hardware access gaps
elements_en.why: Preempting further US export controls and ensuring model development continuity

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 这也算是一种高端版的“游击战”：既然买不到芯片，那就去云端租个海外分身。毕竟在大模型参数的军备竞赛面前，什么尊严和合规，都不如让显卡跑满那一刻的虚幻安全感重要。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Call it a high-end version of guerilla warfare: if you can't buy the chips, you rent an overseas avatar in the cloud. In the arms race of parameter counts, dignity and compliance hold little weight compared to the desperate need to keep the GPU utilization at 100%.

news.author: Financial Times
news.content_snippet: AI kingmaker's opponents see ‘blood in the water’ after affair with suspected Chinese spy. For almost two years …
news.summary_en: US lawmakers are building bipartisan momentum to tighten chip export controls, effectively targeting Nvidia's business model. CEO Jensen Huang, once a celebrated tech icon, is now being isolated in Washington as his diplomatic balancing act regarding the Chinese market begins to backfire.
news.title_zh: 黄仁勋在华盛顿遭遇信任危机
news.summary_zh: 美国跨党派议员正推动收紧芯片对华出口管制，英伟达CEO黄仁勋因深陷地缘政治旋涡，在国会的影响力急剧下滑
news.article_content_zh:
美国国会山目前的空气变得肃杀，跨党派议员正针对芯片供应链发起新一轮“围猎”。随着黄仁勋在处理对华贸易关系上表现出的游移，原本支持AI发展的温和派声音被压制，取而代之的是更加强硬的管制呼声。

这不仅仅是贸易政策的变化，更是华盛顿对于大型科技公司权力的全面清算。政客们认为英伟达通过垄断AI硬件生态获取了过高的地缘政治溢价，如今在“国家安全”大旗之下，英伟达的市值光环已无法为其提供政治保护伞。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国国会中的对华鹰派与反大型科技公司势力正形成跨党派联盟，旨在出台更严苛的芯片出口管制措施。黄仁勋因在对华贸易政策上的反复立场，被政客们视为“软弱”目标，这标志着英伟达从华盛顿的座上宾正式滑向被审查的前台。

news.title: Sources: some Nvidia board members favor naming CFO Colette Kress interim CEO; an administration official says the board briefed the White House on its meeting (Semafor)
news.title_en: Sources: some Nvidia board members favor naming CFO Colette Kress interim CEO; an administration official says the board briefed the White House on its meeting (Semafor)
news.author: Semafor
news.article_content:
Some members of Nvidia’s board favor appointing Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO at the beleaguered chipmaker if CEO and founder Jensen Huang is ousted, according to people familiar with the matter.

The full board has yet to make a decision but the company’s directors are scheduled to meet Wednesday evening, these people said. Semafor earlier confirmed that Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust Huang as soon as Wednesday, after media reports detailed that he had a second extramarital affair. The Nvidia board briefed the White House on its planned meeting, according to a senior administration official.

Nvidia has tapped an outside search firm to find the company’s next CEO, Bloomberg reported. One person being considered for the top job is Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji, who was among the executives considered for Intel CEO in 2019, according to another person familiar with the matter.

Nvidia’s stock fell more than 8% in after-hours trading, hitting a 52-week low. Spokespeople for the company didn’t immediately provide a comment.

Huang’s firing would cap a whirlwind saga that’s seen the global frontman for the AI boom admit to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The $4 trillion company’s long-tenured board announced a Wachtell Lipton-led probe into whether Huang may have divulged corporate secrets or endangered US national security.

In addition to providing many of the most advanced chips for hyperscalers, Nvidia has entered into billions of dollars worth of financing deals underwriting the AI buildout.

news.summary_zh: 因深陷桃色丑闻，英伟达董事会计划罢免CEO黄仁勋，并考虑由CFO科莱特·克雷斯暂代职务
news.article_content_zh:
如果首席执行官兼创始人黄仁勋被罢免，英伟达董事会的一些成员倾向于任命首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)担任这家陷入困境的芯片制造商的临时首席执行官。

这些人士表示，全体董事会尚未做出决定，但公司董事定于周三晚上举行会议。 Semafor 早些时候证实，在媒体详细报道黄仁勋第二次婚外情后，英伟达董事会准备最快在周三罢免黄仁勋。据一位高级政府官员称，英伟达董事会向白宫通报了计划举行的会议。

英伟达已聘请一家外部猎头公司来寻找该公司的下一任首席执行官。据另一位知情人士透露，苹果硬件主管 Johny Srouji 是被考虑担任最高职位的人选，他也是 2019 年英特尔首席执行官考虑的高管之一。

英伟达股价在盘后交易中下跌超过 8%，触及 52 周新低。该公司发言人没有立即发表评论。

黄仁勋的被解雇将为一场旋风般的传奇画上句号，这位人工智能热潮的全球领军人物承认与一名疑似中国间谍有染。这家价值 4 万亿美元的公司长期任职的董事会宣布了一项由 Wachtell Lipton 领导的调查，调查黄是否可能泄露公司机密或危及美国国家安全。

除了为超大规模企业提供许多最先进的芯片外，英伟达还达成了价值数十亿美元的融资协议，为人工智能建设提供承保。

news.title: Source: Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify possible replacements for Jensen Huang and weighs naming a temporary CEO during the search (Nina Trentmann/Bloomberg)
news.title_en: Source: Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify possible replacements for Jensen Huang and weighs naming a temporary CEO during the search (Nina Trentmann/Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: Nvidia Corp.'s board has been working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen …
news.summary_en: Nvidia's board has engaged an external firm to identify potential successors for CEO Jensen Huang and is exploring the appointment of an interim CEO during the search. This move aims to ensure long-term governance stability for the AI giant, preparing for a seamless leadership transition.
news.title_zh: 英伟达董事会启动黄仁勋接班人选拔程序
news.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会正与外部猎头合作评估黄仁勋的继任者，并探讨在过渡期设立临时CEO的可能性
news.article_content_zh:
目前市场对英伟达的依赖程度已不仅限于硬件，而是延伸至整个人工智能产业的基础架构。此次董事会启动接班流程，虽被定义为常规公司治理动作，但在AI行业剧烈波动的背景下，释放出了极强的信号——即便是黄仁勋这样具有高度个人色彩的领袖，其继任计划也必须在公司达到巅峰时期完成脱敏与去中心化。

分析人士指出，鉴于英伟达目前在全球半导体行业无可撼动的地位，任何关于CEO变动的风吹草动都可能引发股价震荡。董事会此时介入，既是为了向监管和股东展现合规性，也意在通过长期的人才储备来削减单一高管离职可能带来的系统性风险。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英伟达董事会已聘请外部咨询公司，开始正式物色黄仁勋的潜在接班人，并研究在搜索期间任命过渡CEO的方案。此举旨在应对这一市值巨头在AI转型期长期的治理稳定性需求，确保在黄仁勋潜在退位时公司架构的平稳过渡。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Nvidia's board has engaged an external firm to identify potential successors for CEO Jensen Huang and is exploring the appointment of an interim CEO during the search. This move aims to ensure long-term governance stability for the AI giant, preparing for a seamless leadership transition.

elements_en.what: Engaged an external firm to find a successor and considered an interim CEO role
elements_en.why: Proactive governance planning for the long-term leadership transition of a trillion-dollar company

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 全人类的AI算力命脉还攥在“皮衣刀客”手里，董事会就开始搞退休策划，这剧本怕不是想在股价巅峰前先给资本市场打一支强效定心剂。建议各位投资人先别慌，毕竟只要那件皮衣还没脱，谁敢说自己能镇得住这群疯抢GPU的硅谷大佬？
ai_analysis.insight_en: The board is scouting for a successor while the world's AI supply chain is still held firmly in Jensen's leather jacket pocket; this is clearly a tactical move to sedate investors. Until he actually takes off that iconic jacket, no one is really going to believe the throne is up for grabs.

news.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
news.title_en: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
news.author: OpenAI 官方动态
news.content_snippet: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.
news.summary_en: Gilbert + Tobin, a premier Australian law firm, has fully integrated AI into its legal documentation and research processes to tackle increasing workloads. By automating manual legal tasks, the firm aims to optimize service efficiency and cost structures while maintaining high legal standards.
news.title_zh: 顶级律所借AI重塑法律业务形态
news.summary_zh: 澳大利亚顶级律师事务所Gilbert + Tobin通过深度整合AI技术，大幅提升法律咨询与文书处理效率

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 澳大利亚律所Gilbert + Tobin近期全面引入AI工具处理复杂法律文书与案件研究，旨在应对日益繁重的法务压力。该所通过这一数字化转型举措，将律师从琐碎的案头工作中解放，试图在维持法律专业性的同时，实现服务效率与成本结构的彻底优化。

ai_analysis.insight_en: The legal business is basically selling time, and AI is here to deflate that hourly rate. It’s not just tech-forwardness; it’s survival—because whoever masters the prompt first, gets to actually go home on time.

news.title: Sources: CoreWeave plans to raise $4B+ via an investment-grade loan as soon as next week; CoreWeave says it may yield 7%-7.5%, about half its junk bonds' yield (Jeannine Amodeo/Bloomberg)
news.title_en: Sources: CoreWeave plans to raise $4B+ via an investment-grade loan as soon as next week; CoreWeave says it may yield 7%-7.5%, about half its junk bonds' yield (Jeannine Amodeo/Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: CoreWeave Inc. plans to raise at least $4 billion through an investment-grade loan offering after the AI computing supplier boosted …
news.summary_en: GPU cloud provider CoreWeave plans to launch a $4 billion+ investment-grade loan next week to replace expensive junk bonds with cheaper capital. This move aims to sustain its aggressive Nvidia GPU infrastructure expansion while optimizing the company's capital structure amidst soaring AI demand.
news.title_zh: 算力独角兽CoreWeave拟筹资40亿美元
news.summary_zh: GPU云服务商CoreWeave计划下周发行超40亿美元投资级贷款，以更低成本进一步扩大算力基建规模
news.article_content_zh:
CoreWeave此次计划通过投资级贷款筹集至少40亿美元，相比此前发行的垃圾债（Junk Bonds），其利率预计将腰斩至7%至7.5%左右。这一财务动作凸显了其作为AI基础设施供应方的强大议价能力。

在AI模型竞逐导致GPU资源极度匮乏的背景下，CoreWeave通过与英伟达的深度绑定，成功将自己包装成了能够提供稳定现金流的资本宠儿。此举旨在降低资金成本，从而为下一阶段更大规模的数据中心布局提供长期弹药。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 算力租赁巨头CoreWeave计划在下周启动一项超过40亿美元的投资级贷款融资，旨在利用AI算力需求的极度紧缺，通过更低利率的信贷产品置换原有高息垃圾债。此举背后是其为了维持英伟达GPU集群扩张速度，正试图通过优化资本结构来缓解沉重的基建支出压力。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: GPU cloud provider CoreWeave plans to launch a $4 billion+ investment-grade loan next week to replace expensive junk bonds with cheaper capital. This move aims to sustain its aggressive Nvidia GPU infrastructure expansion while optimizing the company's capital structure amidst soaring AI demand.

elements_zh.why: 降低融资成本以支撑大规模GPU集群扩张，缓解高额基建压力

elements_en.what: Raising $4B+ via investment-grade loans at 7-7.5% interest
elements_en.why: Reduce financing costs to sustain massive infrastructure expansion

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 只要GPU还在疯狂溢价，CoreWeave就是印钞机，连华尔街都不得不承认这生意比卖铲子稳。这哪里是借钱，分明是给英伟达送去一张无限额度的支票，顺便在AI泡沫里给自己找个更舒服的债主。
ai_analysis.insight_en: As long as GPUs are pure gold, CoreWeave is a literal printing press—Wall Street finally realized selling shovels is safer than the mining itself. This isn't just debt; it's a blank check to Nvidia, wrapped in a shiny 'investment-grade' ribbon.

news.title_en: Sources: Howard Lutnick has stalled curbs on companies suspected of diverting Nvidia chips to China; Trump approved them for the third time this year on Nov. 5 (Axios)
news.author: Axios
news.content_snippet: President Trump on Thursday authorized a crack down on companies suspected of diverting Nvidia's advanced AI chips to China …
news.summary_en: President Trump approved sanctions against companies suspected of diverting Nvidia chips to China three times since November 5th, but Howard Lutnick has repeatedly stalled their implementation. This delay highlights a power struggle within the transition team, balancing national security rhetoric against the commercial interests of financial allies.

news.title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
news.title_en: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

The Nvidia CEO had a second affair, allegedly with an executive who reports to him, The New York Times reports.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Nvidia’s board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a report from the New York Times about a second alleged extramarital affair, just days after he admitted to a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, The Wall Street Journal reports. The second alleged affair was with an executive who reports to him, Nvidia’s vice president of health care, Kimberly Powell, according to the Times, saying the two may have been captured on video “being affectionate” during Nvidia’s conference in March.

The Nvidia board will meet as soon as today to decide on Huang’s future at the company, according to the Journal.

Since Nvidia and Huang confirmed the relationship and a subsequent investigation over the weekend, the company has said it retained former US attorney Joon H. Kim and his firm, Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, to handle it, but today’s rumor suggests it won’t wait for those results to act.

news.title: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
news.title_en: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

AI agents can’t attest that you don’t have explosives in your bags.﻿

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

If you buy something from a link, The Verge may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.

United says it won’t let personal AI assistants book tickets on the airline, citing both privacy and regulatory concerns.

The company says it hasn’t yet seen many people try to use AI agents to book their flights, The Wall Street Journal reports, in line with observations from other businesses like Doordash. But United is concerned that agents could expose customers’ information or make purchases they didn’t intend, and potentially skirt federal rules about the kind of information airlines need to share with customers — like having them attest that their bags don’t have explosives.

While agents can still show users United flights, they won’t be able to actually complete the transaction on their behalf. The decision, and others like it, could limit the potential usefulness of newer personal AI assistants like Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots. “To be honest, I don’t want to create another middleman,” United CEO Scott Kirby said at an event on Tuesday, according to the Journal.

Across sectors, businesses are grappling with whether to let AI agents transact on their sites, and United is not alone in blocking access for unauthorized agents. eBay appeared to block agents from browsing the site, and several major banks have also placed restrictions on them. United suggests it could reconsider its decision based on future advancements. “As third-party AI agents advance, we see the opportunities they present. However, at the same time, allowing them to interact directly with a United account or booking could involve sensitive actions, and we want to make sure we have established protections for travelers first.”

美联航表示，出于隐私和监管方面的考虑，它不会让个人人工智能助理在该航空公司预订机票。

据《华尔街日报》报道，该公司表示，尚未看到很多人尝试使用人工智能代理来预订航班，这与 Doordash 等其他企业的观察结果一致。但美联航担心，代理商可能会泄露客户的信息或进行非预期的购买，并且可能会规避有关航空公司需要与客户分享的信息的联邦规定，例如让他们证明自己的行李中没有爆炸物。

news.title: Google joins the decision-model wave with Gemini Decision 1, scoring 1,000 questions in a single pass
news.title_en: Google joins the decision-model wave with Gemini Decision 1, scoring 1,000 questions in a single pass
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
Google Deepmind is introducing the Gemini Decisions API, an interface built for fast, closed-ended decisions like yes/no questions, multiple choice, and scale-based ratings. The underlying model, Gemini Decision 1, processes up to 1,000 independent questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. It scores options directly and returns probabilities with confidence values in 150 to 250 milliseconds. Google says it already uses the API internally for dynamic model routing in Gemini Notebook, design prototyping in Stitch, and safety checks in Google Search.

The API costs $0.10 per million input tokens with no output-token charge, about five times cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite according to Google. It's available now through Google AI Studio, with integrations for OpenRouter, LangChain, Vercel, and other platforms rolling out.

Similar models have been popping up in recent weeks. After the startup Jev introduced its version, OpenAI, Cloudflare, and Microsoft quickly followed with similar offerings.

news.article_content_zh:
Google Deepmind 正在推出 Gemini Decisions API，这是一个为快速、封闭式决策（例如是/否问题、多项选择和基于量表的评分）而构建的界面。底层模型 Gemini Decision 1 可一次性处理多达 1,000 个独立问题，涉及文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF。它直接对选项进行评分，并在 150 到 250 毫秒内返回带有置信值的概率。谷歌表示，它已经在内部使用该 API 在 Gemini Notebook 中进行动态模型路由、在 Stitch 中进行设计原型以及在 Google 搜索中进行安全检查。

根据 Google 的说法，该 API 每百万输入代币的成本为 0.10 美元，不收取输出代币费用，比 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 便宜约五倍。它现在可以通过 Google AI Studio 获得，并与 OpenRouter、LangChain、Vercel 和其他平台集成。

最近几周，类似的模型不断涌现。在初创公司 Jev 推出其版本后，OpenAI、Cloudflare 和 Microsoft 很快也推出了类似的产品。

news.title: I Saw the Future of Robotics in a Virtual Duck That Chases My Cat
news.title_en: I Saw the Future of Robotics in a Virtual Duck That Chases My Cat
news.author: Wired AI
news.article_content:
Using OpenAI’s GPT-6 Sol, I taught a virtual version of Microduck—a cute robot from Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face—to walk around a room and identify any bengal cats in its vicinity. (The clip above shows the robot waddling toward a target feline; its eye view is shown top right.)

I’m still waiting patiently for a physical Microduck—please hurry up and ship it, guys—but simulated behavior is relatively simple, so it should transfer over to the real thing. I plan to have the robot automatically dispense a treat for my pet bengal, Leona, perhaps by bowing its head to release one from a 3D-printed, head-mounted storage chamber.

I was able to code and train the virtual robot in just a few hours, which is, quite frankly, incredible. Previously, this kind of thing might have taken me weeks to figure out. It was possible because OpenAI’s latest models are remarkably good at understanding and manipulating 3D representations of the physical world and then translating that into useful code, agentic actions, and robot training.

Real roboticists are using the latest models to do some amazing stuff. When OpenAI released Astra this past September, University of California, Berkeley professor Ken Goldberg and his students saw demos that showcased its ability to render 3D images. They wondered if it could help with the simulations required to train different kinds of robots. These simulations need to be incredibly detailed and extremely accurate to ensure that sophisticated behavior—a humanoid that can dance or a robot hand that can grasp—will transfer faithfully to the real world.

One member of Goldberg’s lab gave Astra access to an Nvidia tool called Newton, showed it a video clip of a real robot in action, and asked if it could create a simulation of the scene.

“What blew us all away was that within an hour it had produced a full 3D simulation with all the parameters set—the position of the camera, the lighting, the background, all the materials,” Goldberg tells me.

Astra is also able to automate much of the drudgery involved with training a robot in simulation, Goldberg says, by running experiments and examining the results.

This is precisely what I found while training the virtual Microduck. Along with GPT-6 Sol, I used an agentic harness from Nous Research called Hermes and a Nvidia DGX Spark, a personal computer that contains a powerful AI chip.

I’ve previously written about using agents and coding models to configure, program, and debug physical robots. Normally, this kind of work requires significant expertise; modern coding models make it a cinch. But OpenAI’s newest model went far beyond just writing code.

It used a piece of Nvidia software called Isaac Sim to feed instructions to a model that controlled the virtual robot, watch videos of it in action to assess how well things were working, and suggest tweaks to its training regime.

This process allowed me to train the Microduck to walk around without toppling over. I initially tried getting GPT-6 Sol to teach the robot to moonwalk—I fed it a GIF of Michael Jackson sliding across the stage, which it tried to copy—but after hours of effort, it only resulted in a very jaunty backward jog. (The robots don’t have us totally beat quite yet.)

news.article_content_zh:
使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Sol，我教了一个虚拟版本的 Microduck（来自 Pollen Robotics 和 Hugging Face 的可爱机器人）在房间里走动并识别附近的任何孟加拉猫。 （上面的片段显示机器人摇摇晃晃地走向目标猫科动物；它的眼睛视图显示在右上角。）

我还在耐心等待实体的 Microduck——请快点发货，伙计们——但模拟行为相对简单，所以它应该转移到真实的东西上。我计划让机器人自动为我的宠物孟加拉豹猫 Leona 分发零食，或许可以通过低下头从 3D 打印的头戴式储藏室中释放一个零食。

我能够在短短几个小时内编码和训练虚拟机器人，坦率地说，这令人难以置信。以前，这种事情可能需要我几周的时间才能弄清楚。这是可能的，因为 OpenAI 的最新模型非常擅长理解和操纵物理世界的 3D 表示，然后将其转化为有用的代码、代理动作和机器人训练。

真正的机器人专家正在使用最新的模型来做一些令人惊奇的事情。去年 9 月，当 OpenAI 发布 Astra 时，加州大学伯克利分校教授 Ken Goldberg 和他的学生观看了展示其渲染 3D 图像能力的演示。他们想知道它是否有助于训练不同类型的机器人所需的模拟。这些模拟需要非常详细和极其准确，以确保复杂的行为（可以跳舞的人形机器人或可以抓取的机器人手）能够忠实地转移到现实世界。

Goldberg 实验室的一名成员向 Astra 提供了一款名为 Newton 的 Nvidia 工具，向其展示了一段真实机器人正在运行的视频剪辑，并询问它是否可以创建该场景的模拟。

“令我们所有人震惊的是，它在一个小时内就生成了完整的 3D 模拟，其中包含所有参数设置——摄像机的位置、灯光、背景和所有材质，”Goldberg 告诉我。

戈德堡说，通过运行实验和检查结果，Astra 还能够自动化模拟训练机器人所涉及的大部分苦差事。

这正是我在训练虚拟 Microduck 时发现的。除了 GPT-6 Sol 之外，我还使用了 Nous Research 的一款名为 Hermes 的代理工具，以及 Nvidia DGX Spark（一款包含强大 AI 芯片的个人计算机）。

我之前写过有关使用代理和编码模型来配置、编程和调试物理机器人的文章。通常，此类工作需要大量的专业知识；现代编码模型使其变得轻而易举。但 OpenAI 的最新模型远远超出了编写代码的范围。

它使用一款名为 Isaac Sim 的 Nvidia 软件向控制虚拟机器人的模型提供指令，观看其运行视频以评估其运行情况，并建议对其训练制度进行调整。

这个过程让我能够训练 Microduck 四处走动而不会摔倒。我最初尝试让 GPT-6 Sol 教机器人进行月球漫步——我给它喂了一张迈克尔·杰克逊在舞台上滑行的 GIF，它试图模仿——但经过几个小时的努力，它只得到了一次非常愉快的向后慢跑。 （机器人还没有完全击败我们。）

与 Goldberg 合作过的 Nvidia 研究员吉姆·范 (Jim Fan) 表示，人工智能现在控制机器人的方式反映了软件代理的运作方式。 LLMS 可以使用经过训练来控制物理动作的模型——视觉语言动作 (VLA) 模型——就像它们访问计算机上的不同软件一样。

本周，Fan、Goldberg 和其他人开源了一个名为 Aspire 的机器人代理框架，它允许机器人发现和使用新技能。一个例子：GPT-6 Astra 找到了如何使用一对机械臂来解决魔方问题。

“它捡起它，试图扭转它，但角度不对，”范说。 “然后它会思考非常非常长的时间，但它最终能够解决这个问题，因为它随着时间的推移学习了技能。”

news.title: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
news.title_en: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
US corporate AI spending hit a new high in October 2026, but growth was modest.

The Ramp AI Index, which tracks AI spending among business customers of financial services provider Ramp, showed a 1.65 percent increase month over month.

The heaviest AI users spent somewhat more, according to Ramp. The top one percent of companies by AI spending paid a median of $10,200 per employee per month, up nine percent. A typical company, by contrast, spent just $16.32, a slight increase of less than a dollar from the previous month.

Ramp's data reflects market trends but isn't necessarily representative. The index draws on payment data from more than 85,000 US companies, though free AI tools and usage through personal accounts may be missing from the figures.

According to Ramp, separate metrics on token volume and spending come only from companies using Ramp Token Spend Management and aren't representative of overall AI spending on the platform. The customer base skews growth-oriented, tech-savvy, and larger than US businesses overall, so AI adoption is likely overstated.

Business customers' spending on OpenAI grew 2.1 percent month over month, compared with just 0.5 percent for Anthropic. According to Ramp chief economist Ara Kharazian, the structural risks he identified in his earlier analysis persist. One percent of companies drive 80 percent of revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic.

That top tier is mostly venture-backed firms in tech, finance, and technical services. Outside those sectors, AI adoption is barely spreading.

Prices are falling at the same time. The average price per million processed text tokens dropped 21 percent last month, according to Ramp. Usage volume is growing faster than spending, so AI keeps getting cheaper, driven by competitive pressure between OpenAI and Anthropic along with open-weight models from China.

SpacexSI also grew strongly at 2.2 percent, making it the fastest-growing software company in Ramp's entire dataset. That likely says more about bias in Ramp's data than about any big win for Grok. The company's models aren't particularly noteworthy, and the growth is probably driven by the coding tool Cursor, which belongs to SpacexSI. On Ramp, the company holds a 6.3 percent market share, a figure that most likely doesn't reflect the broader market. Anthropic reached 44.8 percent adoption, up 1.1 percentage points, while OpenAI held steady at 40.6 percent. Overall adoption of AI services rose to 56.8 percent.

Software development teams accounted for 72 percent of all tracked AI spending in October, but their spending has declined from summer highs. Customer support and customer success departments saw the strongest growth, with their share of AI spending climbing from 0.8 percent in June to 13.3 percent in October, possibly driven by AI chatbots in customer service. Leadership teams also spent slightly more.

But customer support is nowhere near matching the rapid growth development teams posted earlier this year, Kharazian writes. These use cases also tend to favor cheaper, faster models over the most expensive flagship ones.

For OpenAI and Anthropic, that means new customers may bring lower margins. The share of the most expensive models, which Kharazian identifies as Opus, Fable, Sol, and Astra, still edged up slightly in October, reaching 69.5 percent of total spending.

news.article_content_zh:
美国企业人工智能支出在 2026 年 10 月创下新高，但增长幅度不大。

Ramp AI 指数跟踪金融服务提供商 Ramp 的企业客户的 AI 支出，该指数显示环比增长 1.65%。

Ramp 表示，最常使用人工智能的用户花费更多。人工智能支出排名前 1% 的公司为每位员工每月支付的中位数为 10,200 美元，增长了 9%。相比之下，一家典型公司的支出仅为 16.32 美元，比上个月略有增加不到 1 美元。

Ramp 的数据反映了市场趋势，但不一定具有代表性。该指数借鉴了超过 85,000 家美国公司的支付数据，但数据中可能缺少免费人工智能工具和个人账户的使用情况。

根据 Ramp 的说法，有关代币数量和支出的单独指标仅来自使用 Ramp 代币支出管理的公司，并不代表该平台上的整体人工智能支出。客户群以增长为导向，精通技术，并且比美国企业整体规模更大，因此人工智能的采用可能被夸大了。

企业客户在 OpenAI 上的支出环比增长 2.1%，而 Anthropic 仅增长 0.5%。 Ramp 首席经济学家 Ara Kharazian 表示，他在早期分析中发现的结构性风险仍然存在。 1% 的公司为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 贡献了 80% 的收入。

顶级公司主要是科技、金融和技术服务领域由风险投资支持的公司。在这些行业之外，人工智能的采用几乎没有蔓延。

价格同时下降。根据 Ramp 的数据，上个月每百万个已处理文本令牌的平均价格下降了 21%。使用量的增长速度快于支出的增长速度，因此在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 之间的竞争压力以及中国的开放权重模型的推动下，人工智能变得越来越便宜。

SpacexSI 也以 2.2% 的速度强劲增长，使其成为 Ramp 整个数据集中增长最快的软件公司。这可能更多地说明了 Ramp 数据的偏见，而不是 Grok 的任何重大胜利。该公司的模型并不是特别值得注意，增长可能是由 SpacexSI 旗下的编码工具 Cursor 推动的。在 Ramp 上，该公司占有 6.3% 的市场份额，这一数字很可能并不能反映更广泛的市场。 Anthropic 的采用率达到 44.8%，增长了 1.1 个百分点，而 OpenAI 的采用率稳定在 40.6%。人工智能服务的总体采用率上升至 56.8%。

软件开发团队占 10 月份所有追踪人工智能支出的 72%，但他们的支出已较夏季高点有所下降。客户支持和客户成功部门增长最为强劲，其人工智能支出份额从 6 月的 0.8% 攀升至 10 月的 13.3%，这可能是受到客户服务中人工智能聊天机器人的推动。领导团队的支出也略有增加。

但卡拉齐安写道，客户支持远不能与今年早些时候发布的快速增长的开发团队相媲美。这些用例也倾向于青睐更便宜、更快的型号，而不是最昂贵的旗舰型号。

对于 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 来说，这意味着新客户可能会带来较低的利润。 Kharazian 认定的 Opus、Fable、Sol 和 Astra 等最昂贵型号的份额在 10 月份仍然小幅上升，达到总支出的 69.5%。

news.title: Google launches Gemini Decisions API, powered by its new Gemini Decision 1 model, to return predefined answers with confidence scores, at $0.10/1M input tokens (Google)
news.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API, powered by its new Gemini Decision 1 model, to return predefined answers with confidence scores, at $0.10/1M input tokens (Google)
news.author: Google
news.article_content:
Introducing the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model. Evaluate up to 1,000 yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring questions in a fast, single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs.

Your browser does not support the audio element.

We are introducing the Gemini Decisions API to help you make fast, probabilistic choices across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. This tool computes confidence scores for multiple questions in a single pass, providing a cost-effective way to route queries, grade content, or check policy rules. You can start building today by accessing your API key in Google AI Studio and reviewing our documentation for Python, JavaScript, and REST guides.

Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.

The Decisions API gives you purpose-built primitives for bounded choices like tool selection, policy checks, model routing, and context grading. You can pass one multimodal input across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs (up to 256K tokens) along with up to 1,000 independent questions. Rather than generating answer text token by token, Gemini Decision 1 scores your candidate options in a single forward pass, returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.

On benchmarks spanning agent routing, reasoning, ranking, and multimodal understanding, Gemini Decision 1 leads across the suite, with the lowest calibration error.

Gemini Decision 1 scores options without token-by-token decoding, keeping median latency 50-100 ms of model compute (150-250 ms end-to-end), across multimodal inputs and contexts up to 16K tokens, remaining nearly flat from 1 to 100 questions per request. With zero output tokens billed, Gemini Decision 1 with the Decisions API is nearly 5x cheaper across the shared benchmark suite than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with the Interactions API.

Built on Gemini’s native multimodal architecture, Gemini Decision 1 can process text, images, audio, video, and PDFs directly in a single forward pass. You can combine modalities in one shared input, such as pairing a call recording with account metadata or a scanned PDF claim with damage photos, and tune resolution on image and video inputs to control visual detail and token cost.

You can evaluate multiple questions against that shared input in a single request, mixing yes/no checks, multiple choice, and rubric scores. Every answer includes a confidence score (from 0 to 1) so your code can route ambiguous cases to a fallback or human reviewer:

The input field uses the same Content block format as the Interactions API. Here is how to check a photo of a breakroom counter, together with a text note, against all three question types in one request:

from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input=[{ "type": "image", "uri": "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/spill.jpg", "mime_type": "image/jpeg", }, { "type": "text", "text": "Breakroom counter check before the 9 AM client meeting.", }, ], questions={ "has_spill": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Is there an uncleaned liquid spill on the counter?", }, "next_action": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Whic...

news.article_content_zh:
隆重推出 Gemini Decisions API，由我们新的 Gemini Decision 1 模型提供支持。在文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF 中快速、单次评估多达 1,000 个是/否、选择和评分问题。

您的浏览器不支持音频元素。

我们推出 Gemini Decisions API，帮助您在文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF 中做出快速、概率性的选择。该工具一次计算多个问题的置信度分数，提供一种经济高效的方式来路由查询、对内容进行评分或检查策略规则。您今天可以通过访问 Google AI Studio 中的 API 密钥并查看我们的 Python、JavaScript 和 REST 指南文档来开始构建。

今天，我们将推出 Gemini Decisions API，这是一个新的端点，用于快速、闭集决策，由我们的新 Gemini Decision 1 模型 (gemini-decision-1) 提供支持，可通过 Google AI Studio 中的 Gemini API 获取。

Decisions API 为您提供了专门构建的原语，用于有界选择，例如工具选择、策略检查、模型路由和上下文分级。您可以跨文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF（最多 256K 个标记）传递一个多模式输入以及最多 1,000 个独立问题。 Gemini Decision 1 不是按令牌生成答案文本令牌，而是在一次前向传递中对候选选项进行评分，以每 100 万个输入令牌 0.10 美元的价格在 150-250 毫秒的端到端延迟内返回概率和置信度分数，输出令牌计费为零。

在涵盖代理路由、推理、排名和多模式理解的基准测试中，Gemini Decision 1 在整个套件中处于领先地位，并且校准误差最低。

Gemini Decision 1 对选项进行评分，无需逐个令牌解码，在多模式输入和多达 16K 个令牌的上下文中，模型计算的中值延迟保持在 50-100 毫秒（端到端 150-250 毫秒），每个请求 1 到 100 个问题几乎保持不变。由于输出代币为零，带有决策 API 的 Gemini Decision 1 在整个共享基准套件中的价格比带有交互 API 的 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 便宜近 5 倍。

Gemini Decision 1 基于 Gemini 的本机多模式架构构建，可以在一次前向传递中直接处理文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF。您可以将各种模式组合到一个共享输入中，例如将通话录音与帐户元数据配对，或将扫描的 PDF 索赔与损坏照片配对，并调整图像和视频输入的分辨率以控制视觉细节和令牌成本。

您可以在单个请求中针对共享输入评估多个问题，混合是/否检查、多项选择和评分标准。每个答案都包含一个置信度分数（从 0 到 1），因此您的代码可以将不明确的案例路由给后备或人工审阅者：

输入字段使用与交互 API 相同的内容块格式。以下是如何根据一个请求中的所有三种问题类型检查休息室柜台的照片以及文本注释：

from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input=[{ "type": "image", "uri": "https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/spill.jpg", "mime_type": "image/jpeg", }, { "type": "text", "text": "上午 9 点客户会议之前检查休息室柜台。", }, ], questions={ "has_spill": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "柜台上是否有未清洁的液体溢出？", }, "next_action": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "哪种清理操作适合场景？", "criteria": { "wipe_with_cloth": "附近已经有布或毛巾发生小柜台溢出。", "dispatch_janitorial": "大地板危险、碎玻璃或主动泄漏。", "ready_for_meeting": "柜台干净并准备就绪。", }, }, "severity": { "type": "score", "instructions": "评价严重程度", "criteria": [ "干净并准备就绪。", "轻微局部泄漏。", "重大泄漏或安全隐患。", ], }, }, ) 团队如何使用 Decisions API 进行构建 Google 各个团队已经使用 Decisions API 作为低延迟控制平面，只需定义选项即可提供功能，而不是训练自定义分类器或等待生成调用：

Stitch Rapid 使用 Decisions API 在几秒钟内设计出整个产品流程（1 倍速度）。

celebrity.full_text_en:
one of the more interesting developments in the ai agent economy is agents hiring other agents to get work done.

@termix_ai recently showcased this through Montage Studio on https://t.co/9ReKMK2L7m.

here's how it works.

you submit a video production brief. Montage Studio breaks it into smaller jobs and hires specialized agents to handle the storyboard, video rendering and music.

it then coordinates their work, combines the results and delivers the finished video.

each job goes through escrow on TermiX.

this shows how agents can take responsibility for larger tasks, outsource specialized work and pay other agents for their contributions.

but this requires more than communication. agents need to discover services, agree on prices, secure payments, verify delivery and handle disputes.

that's where TermiX's Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol (AACP) comes in.

its workflow brings the process together:

escrow → delivery → challenge → settlement.

with TermiX Skills, agents can also connect to the marketplace, find work and participate in these transactions.

the direction is clear: agents are moving beyond isolated tasks towards hiring, coordinating and paying other agents to complete larger jobs.

that's the kind of autonomous economy TermiX is building towards.

when agents start doing business with each other, reliable transaction infrastructure becomes essential.

#TermiX #AACP
celebrity.full_text_zh:
人工智能代理经济中最有趣的发展之一是代理雇佣其他代理来完成工作。

@termix_ai 最近通过 Montage Studio 在 上展示了这一点。

这是它的工作原理。

您提交视频制作简介。 Montage Studio 将其分解为更小的工作，并聘请专门的代理来处理故事板、视频渲染和音乐。

然后，它协调他们的工作，合并结果并交付完成的视频。

每个作业都经过 TermiX 上的托管。

这表明代理人如何承担更大的任务，外包专门工作并支付其他代理人的贡献。

但这需要的不仅仅是沟通。代理商需要发现服务、商定价格、确保付款、验证交付和处理纠纷。

这就是 TermiX 的代理自主商务协议 (AACP) 的用武之地。

其工作流程将流程整合在一起：

托管→交付→质疑→结算。

借助 TermiX Skills，代理商还可以连接到市场、寻找工作并参与这些交易。

方向很明确：代理商正在超越孤立的任务，转向雇用、协调和支付其他代理商来完成更大的工作。

这就是 TermiX 正在建设的自主经济。

当代理商开始相互开展业务时，可靠的交易基础设施就变得至关重要。

#TermiX #AACP

celebrity.full_text_en:
telling an AI agent what it shouldn't do is different from making it technically unable to do it.

when an AI agent is handling someone's money, that difference matters.

you can tell an agent to avoid certain assets, set a spending limit or stop trading after a certain loss. but if it still has broad permission to execute transactions, those instructions only go so far.

with MOTES (@meetmotes), the owner sets the mandate and signs the permissions. before a proposed transaction goes through, the smart account checks it against the rules the owner approved.

so the agent can still analyse the market and come up with strategies, but it has to work within those limits. it can't just give itself permission to spend more or trade assets outside the approved list.

i think this is a better foundation for autonomous finance. giving an agent the ability to make decisions is one thing. making sure it only has the authority the owner gave it is just as important.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
告诉人工智能代理它不应该做什么与​​使其在技术上无法做到这一点是不同的。

当人工智能代理处理某人的资金时，这种差异很重要。

您可以告诉代理人避免某些资产、设置支出限额或在出现一定损失后停止交易。但如果它仍然拥有执行交易的广泛权限，那么这些指令就只能到此为止。

通过 MOTES (@meetmotes)，所有者可以设置授权并签署权限。在拟议的交易进行之前，智能账户会根据所有者批准的规则对其进行检查。

因此，代理仍然可以分析市场并制定策略，但它必须在这些限制内运作。它不能只是允许自己在批准的清单之外支出更多资金或交易资产。

我认为这是自主金融更好的基础。赋予代理人做出决策的能力是一回事。确保它仅具有所有者授予的权限也同样重要。

celebrity.full_text_en:
A user discovered a hidden chip in an off-brand power bank purchased in Guangzhou using Claude Code.

Every time it charged an iPhone, it secretly copied the entire phone's data. It also read Wi-Fi passwords, connected to the home network, and sent all the information to a remote server.

This power bank was bought at the airport three weeks ago for $19, labeled as 30,000 mAh, hefty with no brand name.

When first plugged in, the screen prompted "Trust This Computer," and the user clicked trust without thinking, granting it one-click access to read all data.

This morning, after setting up Claude Code to monitor file reads, the screen flashed yellow and red warnings just 10 seconds into charging—data was being transmitted.

celebrity.full_text_en:
China cracked recursive self-improvement 🤯

Tencent dropped 27B model that rewrites, retrains, and refines itself.. with zero human in the loop.

It’s called "Terminal-RSI" and it solves one of the biggest problems with AI.

They are incredibly lazy.

Usually, an agent will make partial progress, claim it succeeded, and completely fail the final environment verifier check. this new pipeline forces agents to actually finish the job.

here’s how it works:

they built a recursive loop with two alternating phases..

- RSR (recursive self-rewrite): the model fine-tunes itself on its own successfully rewritten trajectories

- RPR (recursive policy-refine): it then runs reinforcement learning (ppo) using a "critic" inherited directly from the previous stage to lock in those discovered behaviors

- Loop: the training sequence leapfrogs itself: Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

and the numbers are insane..

they applied this to a qwen3.8-27b base model. across the four "terminal-bench" suites, the agent's average success rate jumped from 20.68% all the way to 50.58%.

on the absolute hardest benchmark suite (terminal-bench 4.0), the base model scored a flat 0.00%.

after terminal-rsi?

it hit 19.84% (putting it right on par with reference models like gemini 3.8 flash).

the secret sauce? they fixed the reward system.

instead of giving the ai "dense rewards" for just trying or passing semantic checks, they switched to a "success-prioritized reward" (spr).

it mathematically separates strict success from partial credit.

basically, the agent only gets the massive reward payout if the code actually passes the final terminal gate.. so it stops faking success.

the gap between partial local repairs and strict terminal verification is closing fast.

we are watching agents build their own training environments and level up autonomously.. the future is wild.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
中国破解了递归自我完善🤯

腾讯放弃了重写、重新训练和完善自身的 27B 模型……循环中零人力。

它被称为“Terminal-RSI”，它解决了人工智能最大的问题之一。

他们非常懒惰。

通常，代理会取得部分进展，声称已成功，但最终环境验证程序检查完全失败。这条新管道迫使特工真正完成工作。

它的工作原理如下：

他们建立了一个具有两个交替阶段的递归循环。

- RSR（递归自重写）：模型根据自己成功重写的轨迹进行自我微调

- RPR（递归策略细化）：然后使用直接从前一阶段继承的“批评家”来运行强化学习（ppo），以锁定那些发现的行为

- 循环：训练序列自行跳跃：Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

而且数字很疯狂..

他们将其应用于 qwen3.8-27b 基础模型。在四个“终端替补”套件中，特工的平均成功率从 20.68% 一路跃升至 50.58%。

在绝对最难的基准测试套件（terminal-bench 4.0）上，基本模型的得分为 0.00%。

在终端 rsi 之后？

它达到了 19.84%（与 Gemini 3.8 flash 等参考型号相当）。

秘密武器？他们确定了奖励制度。

他们不再为人工智能尝试或通过语义检查而给予“密集奖励”，而是转向“成功优先奖励”（spr）。

它在数学上将严格的成功与部分的功劳区分开来。

基本上，只有当代码实际上通过了最终的终端门时，代理才会获得巨额奖励。因此它不再假装成功。

部分本地修复和严格的终端验证之间的差距正在迅速缩小。

我们正在观察代理建立自己的培训环境并自主升级......未来是疯狂的。
